name: KrispCall
summary: Virtual numbers across 100+ countries with a shared dashboard, dialer and CRM hooks, priced per user. Calls and SMS are pay-as-you-go from a separate credit balance, so compare per-country call rates at your volume rather than the seat price.
best_for: sales and support teams that need virtual numbers across many countries with a shared dashboard, dialer and CRM hooks at a budget seat price
skip_if: your calling is domestic-only at low volume (simpler tools suffice), or you need enterprise reliability guarantees over price
honest_knock: Same honest math as most budget VoIP: the plan buys the platform, the meter buys the conversations — per-minute and per-SMS charges land on top of every seat, so the comparison that matters is call-rate-per-country at your volume. The 100+ country number coverage is genuinely the draw; verify number availability and local regulations for your specific target countries before committing.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month billed annually, or $15 monthly (up to 5 users)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-07 against the vendor's own pricing page) Since our August reading the plans have been renamed and a tier added: Starter $12 per user/mo billed annually or $15 monthly, for teams up to 5 users; Advance $32 or $40, up to 50 users; Max $48 or $60, with no member limit; Enterprise custom, quoted as volume pricing for 50+ seats. Annual saves 20%, which the page puts at $36, $96 and $144 per user a year; that checks out against the monthly rates. Each plan includes one free US, Canadian or UK number per user, $1 of testing credit, and a monthly allowance per user: Starter 200 outbound and 200 inbound call minutes and 100 SMS segments; Advance 1,000, 1,000 and 500; Max unlimited calling under a fair-usage policy and 1,000 segments. SMS allowances are pooled across the users on a plan, and the included calling covers local numbers in the US, Canada, UK and Australia. Additional calls, SMS and numbers are billed at usage rates from a separate credit balance. US business texting needs A2P 10DLC registration at the same price on every plan: $4.50 brand registration and $15 campaign vetting, one-off, plus $1.50 a month for a low-volume campaign or $2 a month for a sole-proprietor campaign. Subscriptions carry a 14-day unconditional refund; add-ons, numbers and credits are non-refundable.
